review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Required Competencies: Hands-on experience implementing and operating Cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes platforms; Experience with Cloud services related to compute, networking, storage and identity; Good knowledge of Linux system administration, including services, permissions, patching, hardening and troubleshooting; Experience with Terraform and Ansible; Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm; Good knowledge of networking and connectivity, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, TLS and SSH; Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, backup and recovery; Knowledge of IAM/RBAC, secrets management and security; Knowledge of Git, Bash, Python and GitLab CI/CD; Experience with Kubernetes networking and storage components, including CNI, CSI and ingress; Advanced English.
